title: SMOK Nord 6 Empty Replacement Pod - 2pk
description: Keep your Smok Nord 6 device performing at its peak with these official replacement empty pods. Specially designed for the Smok Nord 6 Pod Vape Kit, these 2ml capacity pods feature an incredibly convenient top-filling mechanism. To refill, simply remove the top cap and insert your e-liquid nozzle into the spring-loaded filling port, ensuring a clean and hassle-free experience without having to remove the pod from the device. These pods are supplied empty and utilise a detachable coil system, meaning they are fully compatible with the popular Smok RPM 4 coil series. This allows you to replace just the coil when the flavour begins to fade, making it a highly cost-effective and environmentally friendly way to vape. Supplied in a handy pack of two. Please Note: Coils are not included and must be purchased separately.
